ag-garden-studio.name: Garden studios
ag-garden-studio.short: Compact studios, priced to match, with Skala beach across the road.
ag-garden-studio.description: Compact, practical studios on the garden side or at the back of the property, some on the ground floor with a partial sea view. Each has a kitchenette, air conditioning and a shower room. They are small and priced to match, and the beach is still just across the road.
ag-garden-studio.bestFor: Budget-minded couples spending their days on the beach

variants.ag-ground-partial-sea: Studio (2 adults) – ground floor, partial sea view

ag-sea-studio.name: Sea-view studios
ag-sea-studio.short: Side, partial or first-floor sea views, opposite Skala beach.
ag-sea-studio.description: Choose a side sea view, or a balcony with a partial view of the sea. The Superior studio looks out over the sea from the first floor. Each is a single open-plan room with a kitchenette and air conditioning.
ag-sea-studio.bestFor: Couples who want to see the sea

variants.ag-balcony-partial-sea: Studio with balcony and partial sea view

ag-triple-studio.name: Triple studio
ag-triple-studio.short: One room for three adults, 20 m from Skala beach.
ag-triple-studio.description: A studio for three adults, all in one open-plan room with a kitchenette and air conditioning. It suits friends or family who are happy to share, and like every unit at Aegealis it is cleaned daily.
ag-triple-studio.bestFor: Three friends or a couple with a teenager

ag-family-studio.name: Family studio with terrace
ag-family-studio.short: Two adults, two children, a sea view and a terrace for breakfast.
ag-family-studio.description: Sleeps two adults and two children, with a sea view and a terrace for breakfast outdoors. One family wrote that you have “much more space than the other hotels on the seafront”. Like every studio here, it has a kitchenette and air conditioning.

variants.ag-family: Family studio with terrace and sea view (2 adults + 2 children)

ag-apartment.name: One-bedroom apartments with sea view
ag-apartment.short: A separate bedroom and space for four, on the ground or upper floor.
ag-apartment.description: A separate bedroom and a main room with a kitchenette, for up to four guests. Choose the ground floor, or the upper floor with a large balcony facing the sea. These are the largest units at Aegealis. In the upper-floor apartment, the air conditioning is in the main room.
ag-apartment.bestFor: Families or friends wanting a door between them

variants.ag-apt-ground: One-bedroom apartment with sea view – ground floor
variants.ag-apt-upper: One-bedroom apartment with sea view – upper floor

th-double.name: Double rooms
th-double.short: Simple, spotless and good value, at the top of the main street.
th-double.description: Simple rooms for two, each with a kitchenette, air conditioning, a shower room and a balcony or terrace. The double room with terrace, on the first floor, has a sea view. Daily cleaning is included, and guests rate Theodora's value for money 9.2.

th-studio.name: Village studios
th-studio.short: A kitchenette for simple meals; one top-floor studio has a sea view.
th-studio.description: Studios on the ground floor or the top floor, each with air conditioning, a shower room and a kitchenette with a hob, fridge, kettle and coffee maker. The ground-floor studios have a front or side view; on the top floor, one studio has a front sea view and the studio apartment overlooks the pool. Some top-floor studios have wooden-beamed ceilings.
th-studio.bestFor: Couples who like to cook a little

th-triple.name: Triple room with terrace
th-triple.short: Room for three, with a terrace that catches the late-afternoon sun.
th-triple.description: A first-floor room for three with a kitchenette and a terrace that overlooks the pool and gets the sun late in the afternoon. Guests describe it as spacious, and it works well for parents with a young child. Please note that Theodora has no cots or extra beds.
th-triple.bestFor: Parents with one child, or three friends

th-two-bedroom.name: Two-bedroom apartments
th-two-bedroom.short: Two bedrooms, a sea view and space for up to five, 100 m from the centre.
th-two-bedroom.description: Two bedrooms plus a kitchen and living area, for up to five guests, on the first or second floor with a front and side sea view. The fifth bed is in the living area and is about 180 cm long, so it suits a child or a shorter adult. It is best for four adults, or four adults and a child.
th-two-bedroom.bestFor: Families and groups of four or five
